outcome: Decision reliability across different surgical specialties
cohort: Four Large Language Models (ChatGPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, and Grok 3) were evaluated using 30 complex surgical cases (10 obstetric, 20 geriatric; across 8 specialties).
finding: DeepSeek performed best in anesthesia decision-making for critically ill obstetric and geriatric patients, significantly outperforming the other LLMs across various dimensions and specialties.
